title: Breathless run-on youth — one continuity slip
source_passage: Okay so we were running, right, we were running down Fenwick and Jonah had the bag and I had the other bag and my heart was going like a drum solo and then Jonah, who was definitely wearing his red jacket, ducks into the alley and we just lose him. My blue coat snagged on the fence but I didn't care.
